newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip in bearish sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip in bearish sentiment.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower on Thursday in continued bearish sentiment, as sluggish overseas markets stimulated constant selling, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen to 1.3 yen per kg lower. Benchmark September was off 1.2 yen at 144.6 yen.
"Sentiment remains bearish as private investors are waiting for any price rebound to sell. With no bullish factors in sight, prices have more scope to slip," one trader said.
Open interest of rubber futures has fallen steadily in recent months, reflecting thin interest in rubber futures, the traders said. --Tokyo Commodity Desk, +81-3-3432-7431
